tokyo_conrow_shibuya_dogenzaka.price_note: Prices tax-included as printed on the shop's Tabelog menu; the restaurant's own site lists the same dishes by name but publishes no prices, so the numbers come from Tabelog. No allergen statement on either. The shop notes the board differs slightly between its Shibuya and Ebisu branches and that seasonal specials run beyond what is listed. ⚠ HOW THIS CUISINE SPLITS THE TWO DIETS, because it is not the usual way round: Thai food is largely RICE-BASED — rice noodles, jasmine rice, sticky rice, rice-paper rolls — so a coeliac has far more to work with here than at most restaurants in this dataset, and the wheat is concentrated in the deep-fried section and the OYSTER SAUCE that seasons the stir-fries. A vegan has the harder time: fish sauce and shrimp paste are foundational, so even the vegetable dishes need a question. The 空芯菜の辛味噌炒め is the closest thing to a plant main and it is still made with 辛味噌 and almost certainly fish sauce. Note also that every item comes with a salad (※全てにサラダが付きます), whose dressing is undeclared.

items.en: Tod man kung — fried prawn cakes
items.note: Battered and deep-fried: wheat coating, shared oil. Prawn surimi is commonly bound with wheat starch as well as coated.

items.ja: エビのガーリック揚げ（クン・トート・ガティアム）
items.en: Kung tod kratiem — garlic fried prawns
items.note: Battered and deep-fried: wheat coating, shared oil. Thai garlic marinades normally include fish sauce and often soy.

items.ja: 豚スペアリブのガーリック揚げ
items.en: Garlic fried pork spare ribs
items.note: Battered and deep-fried: wheat coating, shared oil.

items.ja: フレンチフライのガーリック和え
items.en: Chips tossed with garlic
items.note: Potato and garlic in themselves, but frozen chips are often flour-dusted and this fryer handles battered prawn and fish cakes. Ask about both the coating and the oil.

items.en: Fresh spring rolls — the shop notes the Thai herbs come through
items.note: FRESH spring rolls are wrapped in RICE paper, not the wheat sheet a fried roll uses — a genuine distinction. The filling and the dipping sauce are undeclared, and the dip is where wheat and fish sauce would enter.

items.ja: 春雨のスパイシーサラダ（ヤム・ウンセン）
items.en: Yam woon sen — spicy glass noodle salad
items.note: Worth knowing: 春雨 glass noodles are MUNG BEAN or potato starch, not wheat, so the noodle is fine. The dressing is fish sauce and lime, and the salad normally carries minced pork and dried shrimp.

items.ja: 青パパイヤのサラダ（ソムタム）
items.en: Som tam — green papaya salad, suggested with gai yang and sticky rice
items.note: Shredded raw papaya, chilli and lime — no wheat in the dish, which makes it a strong coeliac prospect. Som tam is dressed with fish sauce and usually dried shrimp, so a vegan needs it made differently.

items.ja: 鶏挽肉のイサーンサラダ（ラープ・ガイ）
items.en: Larb gai — Isaan minced chicken salad
items.note: Larb is minced meat, herbs, lime and toasted RICE powder — the thickener is rice, not flour. Fish sauce throughout.

items.ja: 発酵ソーセージとおこげのサラダ（ネーム・クルック）
items.en: Nam khluk — fermented sausage and crisped rice salad; the shop calls this the owner's number one recommendation
items.note: The おこげ here is crisped RICE, not a crouton — this dish is built on deep-fried rice balls broken up through the salad, so its crunch comes from rice rather than wheat. Fish sauce and pork.

items.ja: 豚トロ肉のスパイシー和え（ナムトック・コームー・ヤーン）

items.note: Grilled pork dressed with lime, chilli and toasted rice powder. Fish sauce.

items.ja: 鶏胸肉のスパイシーサラダ

items.ja: 海老とレモングラスのサラダ

items.ja: シーフードのスパイシーサラダ（ヤム・タレー）

items.ja: 豚トロ肉焼き（コームー・ヤーン）
items.en: Kor moo yang — grilled pork jowl
items.note: Grilled pork; Thai grilling marinades often use soy or oyster sauce alongside fish sauce, and the dipping sauce (nam jim jaew) is fish-sauce based.

items.ja: タイ風ローストチキン（ガイヤーン）
items.en: Gai yang — Thai roast chicken, served on a hot iron plate

items.ja: シーフードのスパイシースープ(トムヤムタレー)
items.en: Tom yum talay — hot and sour seafood soup
items.note: Lemongrass, galangal, lime and chilli with no wheat in the classic build. Fish sauce and seafood rule out vegan.

items.ja: 牛肉のタイハーブ炒め
items.en: Beef stir-fried with Thai herbs
items.note: Thai stir-fries are seasoned with OYSTER SAUCE and soy sauce — both wheat routes and both animal.

items.ja: ソフトシェルクラブの玉子カレー炒め（プーニム・パット・ポンカリー）
items.en: Poo nim pad pong curry — soft-shell crab in curry powder and egg

items.ja: シーフードのガパオ炒め（パット・ガパオ・タレー）
items.en: Pad gaprao talay — seafood holy basil stir-fry

items.ja: シーフードの甘辛味噌炒め（タレー・パット・ナンプリックパオ）
items.en: Talay pad nam prik pao — seafood in sweet chilli jam
items.note: Nam prik pao is a roasted chilli jam built on dried shrimp and fish sauce, and the stir-fry adds oyster and soy sauce.

items.ja: 空芯菜と豚肩ロースの辛味噌炒め（パット・パックブン・ファイデーン・サイムー）
items.romaji: patto pakku bun faidēn sai mū
items.en: Pad pak boong fai daeng with pork shoulder — water spinach in hot bean sauce
items.note: Thai stir-fries are seasoned with OYSTER SAUCE and soy sauce — both wheat routes and both animal. Pak boong is specifically made with fermented soybean and oyster sauce.

items.ja: 空芯菜の辛味噌炒め（パット・パックブン・ファイデーン）
items.en: Pad pak boong fai daeng — water spinach in hot bean sauce
items.note: The closest thing on this board to a plant main, and it still does not get there without a conversation: pak boong is stir-fried with fermented soybean paste and oyster sauce, which is both a wheat route and an animal one, and fish sauce is the usual finish. Ask whether it can be made with garlic and chilli alone.

items.ja: 鶏肉と春雨のチリソース炒め（パット・ウンセン）
items.en: Pad woon sen — chicken and glass noodles in chilli sauce

items.ja: レッドカレー炒め 鶏or豚（パット・ピッ・ゲーン）

items.ja: 鶏肉と生姜のタイ味噌炒め（ガイ・パット・キン）

items.ja: 鶏肉とカシューナッツの炒め（ガイ・パット・メッ・マムワン）
items.en: Gai pad med mamuang — chicken with cashew nuts

items.en: Pad thai — the shop calls it the Thai standard
items.note: The noodle is RICE, so the usual noodle objection does not apply — what rules it out as served is the sauce: tamarind with fish sauce, frequently soy. Contains egg and normally dried shrimp and crushed peanut.

items.ja: 激辛太麺焼きそば（センヤイ・パット・キーマオ）
items.en: Pad kee mao sen yai — very hot wide-noodle stir-fry
items.note: セン・ヤイ are wide RICE noodles despite the 焼きそば in the Japanese name — the noodle itself is fine. The sauce is not: pad kee mao is built on soy and oyster sauce.

items.ja: グリーンカレー(ライス付）
items.en: Green curry, served with rice
items.note: A strong coeliac prospect: Thai green curry is curry paste and coconut milk over rice, with no flour roux and no bread anywhere near it. Green curry paste conventionally contains shrimp paste and the dish is finished with fish sauce, so a vegan needs it made differently. Thai cooking is built on ナンプラー (fish sauce) and frequently shrimp paste, so a dish with no visible meat is still rarely vegan without asking.

items.en: Gaprao rice
items.note: Rice-based, but gaprao seasoning is oyster and soy sauce, and it is topped with a fried egg.

items.en: Prawn fried rice
items.note: Rice-based; Thai fried rice is seasoned with fish sauce and often soy.

items.en: Khao man gai — poached chicken on rice cooked in its stock
items.note: Chicken and rice with nothing battered or floured — among the best prospects on this menu. The dipping sauce is the question, and it is normally soy- and fermented-bean-based, so ask whether it can come on the side.

items.ja: グリーンカレーリゾット
items.en: Green curry risotto
items.note: Rice and curry paste; a risotto is normally finished with butter and cheese, which would rule out vegan on a second count. Thai cooking is built on ナンプラー (fish sauce) and frequently shrimp paste, so a dish with no visible meat is still rarely vegan without asking.

items.en: Jasmine rice
items.note: Steamed rice and nothing else — the safest order on the board, and the thing to build a meal around here.

items.en: Khao niao — Thai sticky rice
items.note: Steamed glutinous rice. Worth stating plainly because the English name misleads: "glutinous" describes the sticky texture and contains NO GLUTEN. Rice and water.

items.en: Na rak sundae
items.note: A sundae — contents not described. Ice cream is dairy, and sundaes normally carry a wafer or biscuit.

items.en: Mango ice cream
items.note: Ice cream is dairy unless made otherwise; no wheat expected but nothing is declared, and any wafer served with it would be.

items.en: Coconut ice cream
items.note: The one dessert worth asking about on both counts: Thai coconut ice cream is traditionally made with coconut milk rather than dairy, which would make it vegan as well as wheat-free. Japanese kitchens often make it with cream instead, and nothing here is declared.

items.en: Mixed ice cream
items.note: Flavours not specified; dairy unless stated otherwise.

tokyo_tsurutontan_udon_noodle_.price_note: Prices tax-included as printed on the shop's Tabelog menu; the chain's own menu page lists seasonal dishes by name but publishes no prices, so the numbers come from Tabelog. No allergen statement on either. Shibuya Scramble Square 13F, open daily 11:00–23:00. ⚠ SAY THE OBVIOUS THING PLAINLY: this is an udon house, udon is wheat, and roughly half this menu is therefore closed to a coeliac before any question is asked. It is recorded in full anyway, because the useful information is WHERE THE EXCEPTIONS ARE — and they are not where you would expect. The noodle sections are uniformly out. The sushi and 逸品 sections are raw fish and rice, limited only by the soy sauce. And the dessert list is the one place a coeliac genuinely has choices: くずきり is kudzu starch and わらびもち is bracken starch, both traditionally wheat-free and both plant-only. A vegan, by contrast, has almost nothing here — the dashi alone rules out the entire noodle menu.

items.en: The house dote-ni — domestic pork offal simmered in miso, one portion
items.note: Dote-ni is offal simmered for hours in miso and mirin, and Osaka dote is normally built on 赤味噌. Two portions or more ¥1,078.

items.ja: 浪速のビリケンポテト
items.en: Naniwa Billiken potatoes
items.note: Seasoning undeclared, and this kitchen's fryer handles panko-crumbed skewers throughout service.

items.ja: 自家製 若鶏のジューシー唐揚げ
items.en: House juicy chicken karaage
items.note: Karaage is flour-dredged and soy-marinated, in a fryer shared with the panko skewers.

items.en: Fried takoyaki, six pieces
items.note: Takoyaki batter is wheat flour, the sauce is a Worcester-style brown sauce, and it is finished with katsuobushi.

items.en: Salted chips
items.note: Salt only, which is the better version — but frozen chips are often flour-dusted and the fryer is shared with panko. Ask about both.

items.ja: 天かすたっぷり ソース焼きそば
items.en: Sauce yakisoba with plenty of tempura crumb
items.section: なにわシリーズ Naniwa series
items.note: Wheat three ways: yakisoba noodles are wheat, 天かす is fried tempura batter, and the sauce is Worcester-style.

items.ja: 浪速の だし巻き玉子
items.en: Naniwa rolled dashi omelette
items.section: なにわシリーズ Naniwa series
items.note: Named for its dashi — bonito stock, normally seasoned with soy. Egg.

items.ja: ロシアンたこ焼き【セーフ】普通のたこ焼き
items.en: Russian roulette takoyaki — ordinary, one piece; the habanero one is the forfeit
items.section: ロシアンたこ焼き Novelty
items.note: Takoyaki batter is wheat flour, with a brown sauce and katsuobushi on top. The habanero version carries no price on the board.

items.en: Griddled pork, egg and kimchi
items.note: Egg and pork; the seasoning is undeclared and kimchi carries its own soy and seafood questions.

items.ja: 昔懐かしタコさんウインナー
items.en: Octopus-cut sausages
items.note: Sausages are commonly bulked with wheat-based rusk or starch; undeclared.

items.en: Bacon with butter
items.note: Bacon and butter — dairy, and the seasoning is undeclared.
